summary: Hyperscale Data, Inc. filed a Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus supplement covering up to $16,216,216.22 of 7.5% OID convertible promissory notes sold to one institutional investor for aggregate cash of $15 million, in two tranches of $10 million (Nov 6, 2026) and $5 million (Nov 16, 2026). Notes carry 8% interest (18% on default), convert at the greater of a $0.1025 floor or the lower of $0.30 and a 10% discount to five-day VWAP, maturing February 2027 (May 2027 if stockholder approval). Capped at 47,176,715 conversion shares under NYSE rules pending approval; last sale $0.1466. This is a routine financing, not a special situation.
